D.name: Panoramic Barrel Sauna
D.intro: A cedar barrel with a full glass back wall, so every session comes with a view of the lake, the trees or your backyard.
specs: 7' wide, by 4' to 14' long depending on size and add-ons
Cedar door with tempered glass, 50" (127 cm) glass height on the 7' model
4.5 mm bronze-tinted acrylic dome with a 180° view; adds 20" (51 cm) to the length
Curved seat at the base of the dome window
Western red cedar, knotty or clear
Cedar staves with stainless steel bands, on cedar cradles
Flat or rounded along the contours of the barrel
Level, with a slight slope at the back for drainage: concrete pad, deck, patio stone or crushed stone
240V, 30–50 amp depending on the heater; final hookup by a licensed electrician
6 kW electric or wood-burning, sized for this room

steps.desc: One package, sized to this sauna. Pick the look and feel you like.

groups.title: Choose your heater package
groups.note: 6 kW suits the smaller barrels. We size the heater up for 7' × 8' and larger in your quote. Every package is ready to fire: the heater, its control and the right fill of stones. Electric heaters need a dedicated 240V circuit installed by a licensed electrician. This sauna is large enough for a wood-burning stove too.

about.title: The barrel, with a view
about.lede: A cedar barrel with a bronze acrylic dome for wide-open views from the bench.
items: A 4.5 mm bronze-tinted acrylic dome replaces the back wall, with a curved half-moon seat at its base.
Every barrel is 7' across; choose the length that seats your crew, from a cozy 2-person to 8 or more.
Front and back windows, an overhanging cove over the door, cedar or metal roofs, and regular, signature or lounge benches. We confirm options and pricing in your quote.
Fire it with a wood-burning stove or a 240V electric heater. Built in Canada from western red cedar.
